entities.name: Ambroise-Auguste Liébeault
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ambroise-Auguste Liébeault was a French physician and is considered the father of modern hypnotherapy. Ambroise-Auguste Liébeault was born in Favières, a small town in the Lorraine region of France, on September 16, 1823. He completed his medical degree at the University of Strasbourg in 1850, at the age of 26.
